name: Legal profession
what: Be admitted as a lawyer and hold a practising certificate in each state or territory, under the Uniform Law where it applies.

layers.who: State admission board, law society or legal services regulator

consistency_note: A uniform law in New South Wales, Victoria and Western Australia; separate laws elsewhere.

basis.source: Professional, scientific and technical services industry (industry information)
basis.quote: Admission as a legal practitioner, through the court system in your state or territory; and A practising certificate in your state or territory.
